===Specifications=== :;Banana Pi RPI R64 board *SoC: [[MediaTek]] MT7622A @1.35GHz :Dual-Core ARM (Cortex-A53) *System Memory: 1GB (DDR3) SDRAM *Storage: 8GB (eMMC) flash, 128MB (SPI NAND) flash, :MicroSD slot (up to 256GB); 1x SATA interface *Network: 5x 10/100/1000Mbps Ethernet ports *Connectivity: USB: 1x USB 3.0 port :1x GbE WAN; 4x GbE LAN ports ([[MediaTek]] MT7531BE) *WLAN: 802.11bgn 4×4, BT 5.0 ([[MediaTek]] MT7622A) :Optional: [[Banana Pi BPI-MT7615-IPA]] (R2/R64) *Expansion: 40-pin GPIO header *Misc: Reset button, 3-pin header for serial console *Power Supply: 12V/2A DC power (barrel) jack :Optional PoE module with support for 12V/3A
